disputes.title: How long is the platinum?

versions.label: A — about 200 hours
versions.text: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase and games.gg all estimate roughly 200 hours to the platinum (60–80 h story, ~100 h for the 100% checklist, 10–20 h cleanup).

versions.label: B — 300+ hours
versions.text: Push Square says to expect up to 300 hours or more, with no fixed estimate from the trophy list itself.

disputes.note: Plan for 200 hours, budget for 300. Both figures are published estimates, not measurements — nobody has played a full 200-hour run on record yet.

disputes.title: What exactly is the final-mission trophy?

versions.label: A — Complete the final mission
versions.text: The official description in the kit list, PowerPyx, Push Square and games.gg all word it as completing the final mission.

versions.label: B — Complete Chapter 5
versions.text: Insider Gaming lists it as Complete Chapter 5; eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word it the same way.

disputes.note: This guide uses the official description (A). The story has 5 chapters; the final mission closes the story either way, so the unlock is the same.

disputes.title: How many shooting-range locations are there?

versions.label: A — 12 locations
versions.text: PowerPyx lists 12 Shooting Range locations holding the 42 challenges.

versions.label: B — 2 locations
versions.text: Push Square names two locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).

disputes.note: All sources agree on the number that matters: 42 challenges, gold medal in each. Find ranges via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

disputes.title: How does Ten Pin actually unlock?

versions.label: A — kick enemies off a motorcycle
versions.text: PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

versions.label: B — method still being confirmed
versions.text: KeenGamer says only that it needs a melee drive-by elimination and the precise method is still being confirmed.

disputes.note: Neither version is confirmed in-game yet. This guide marks Ten Pin METHOD UNCONFIRMED and shows both.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops automatically. Everything is single-player: no online trophies, no DLC trophies, no difficulty setting. Plan on roughly 200 hours (PowerPyx) — Push Square says 300+ — with most of it spent on the 100% checklist for A Long Road [3][4][5].

steps.text: Finish the story (Chapters 1–5) and the 12 story trophies; they cannot be missed.
Do the one possibly missable thing first: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, before Chapter 1 ends.
Work the 100% Completion checklist after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) — it is the longest grind and unlocks A Long Road.
Clean up the stranger finals, activities, robberies and money trophies; the platinum unlocks the moment the 54th other trophy pops.
Keep cheats off the whole run: they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed and pops as part of the story [3][4].

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it is the first mission of the game.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops on completion. No extra objective is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. PowerPyx notes it pops as the next chapter opens, after the first main mission of Chapter 2 [3][4].

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's main missions to the end of the chapter.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia — the only possibly missable trophy moment in the game.
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 completes; keep a manual save at the chapter boundary.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete Chapter 2. It cannot be missed; PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3 [3][4].

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2's main missions, including Coffee Break — the mission that unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia.
The trophy pops on completing the chapter. No side content is required for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete Chapter 3. It cannot be missed; PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 [3][4].

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3's main missions, including The Cartel Heist.
Pick up the optional questlines that open in Chapter 3 (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) — they feed later trophies.
The trophy pops on completing the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete Chapter 4. It cannot be missed; PowerPyx notes it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero [3][4].

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4's main missions, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks the bank-vault robberies.
The trophy pops on completing the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the final mission. It cannot be missed. Sources differ on the wording — the official description says 'Complete the final mission', while Insider Gaming lists it as 'Complete Chapter 5' — both versions are shown in this guide [1][3][7][11].

steps.text: Finish the story through Chapter 5 to the final mission.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops and free-roam continues afterwards.
After the story, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It cannot be missed [3][4].

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. It is not true 100% — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles are only partly required. The checklist only becomes visible after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made earlier already counts [3][4][5].

steps.text: During the story, do optional missions as they appear and scan vehicles / study animals — you need 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.

After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: all robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans.
Finish the activity lines: 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be done in post-story free-roam.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. Mix the four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps. Under the Bridges are the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops [3][4][5].

steps.text: Open Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see found and completed stunts by name; each stays marked after completion.
Start with Under the Bridges (202 available): fly a plane under bridges — the fastest category to farm.
Mix in Stunt Jumps off ramps, Knife Flights between Vice City buildings, and Base Jumps from peaks and tall buildings.
Performing a stunt once counts as completed; the extra challenges shown on map icons are not required.
Track totals under Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 on a category for progress by region).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You will be introduced to most of them by the story, and the rest are marked when you unfog the map. Check Touch Pad > Progress > Activities to see how many of each type you have done [3][4][5].

steps.text: Do one of each: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), playing a Video Game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a Stunt.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find anything you have not tried yet.
You will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist — check the counter before grinding it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Sources differ on how many range locations exist — PowerPyx lists 12, Push Square names 2 (Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero) — but all agree on 42 challenges [3][4][5].

steps.text: Find ranges on the map via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers; work through them and earn gold in each of the 42.
Some challenges are locked until you meet other conditions, shown on the map — clear those first.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. The 100% checklist also needs all 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Some locations charge an entry fee. The 100% checklist needs all 42 Drone Time Trials completed as well [3][4][5].

steps.text: Find locations on the map via Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations — you do not need to win all 42 races for this trophy.
Bring cash for entry fees at some locations.
Keep racing afterwards: the 100% checklist wants all 42 Drone Time Trials done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 race locations. Winning the same race repeatedly does not count — each win must be a different race. The 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 won [3][4][5].

steps.text: Track every race location under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Most locations let you hire a car — check its Rating, and upgrade your own car at Mod Shops if you race it.
Win 20 distinct races; keep going to 30 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline. Push Square adds the detail: catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg in the marked area [3][4].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal, then wait for his text marking a fishing spot.
Go to the marked spot with a boat and a fishing rod — hijack a boat nearby if you do not own one.
Fish in the marked area until you catch the fish Cal wants (Push Square: a Parrotfish over 2 kg).
Beat Cal's challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are 4: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. Finish all levels of one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge in it [3].

steps.text: Play Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home using the controllers — available from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world instead.
Finish all levels of any one game at least once; pick whichever you like best.
For the 100% checklist you must play all 4 games, so try the rest later.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3. Quest givers can go temporarily quiet mid-story (PowerPyx), so do Andy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them all for post-story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only: during Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests; all remain available after the story [3].

steps.text: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia until Andy calls and texts her address in Belville.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3).
Complete Pay the Cellerica Fee, then Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation).
Complete Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), then Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) — the trophy pops on this final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2–3 (PowerPyx). Do not panic if he vanishes — he comes back, and all his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline opens in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks; the final mission is Maritime Disputes (Push Square) [3][4].

steps.text: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, answer Kenton's call and find him at the KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the shipwrecks he marks (purple treasure-chest icons), using the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring each set back.
After the first set he calls you back to his shop, then marks more locations — 7 shipwrecks in total.
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1, keep playing — he texts again in Chapter 2–3 (or call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up). Finish his final mission, Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Do his missions when they appear; all remain available after the story (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 quests; the final one is Hometown Heroes [3][4].

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Thrillbillies (check out the Mud Club).
Complete Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab and Mall Rats (join Billy on jobs).
Complete The Impaler (steal the Impaler), then Hometown Heroes — the trophy pops on this final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Yasmani do NOT count. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; more are still being discovered. Use the trophy tracker in the trophy list to count, not your total optional missions [3][9].

steps.text: Find Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove): Search for the Skunk Ape, search for Tree Effigies, help Kirk find Mr. Mangrove.
Find Kyle: check out McKittrick Farm, collect chemicals for Kyle, then check on Kyle (Buddy?).
Find Yago: join a street race, mentor Yago (Bumper to Bumper), race against Yago, back Yago up (Brother to Brother).
Find Pilot Pete: The Last Mile — Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, then Pete's Deliveries.
Do NOT count Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses or Yasmani questlines toward this trophy — the game does not count them as strangers.
Strangers stay available after the story in free-roam; check the trophy tracker for your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Randy's questline opens in Chapter 3 and stays available after the story (PowerPyx). His wish-list cars are the long part — start delivering early.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered; the list includes the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Tempesta, the Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, and the Grotti Itali RSX [3].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS and deliver the Granforma Zorrusso — this unlocks the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Track the 16 wanted cars under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some in fixed locations and more as you complete them.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then steal and drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Sports cars spawn often in east Vice City around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.
Delivering in good condition pays more. Finish all 16 to complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3. All of it stays available after the story (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only: after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This [3][4].

steps.text: As Jason in Chapter 3, finish Here, Kitty Kitty to reveal the Synthetic Labs markers.
Go to the labs and destroy them (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter).
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone offers Spin On This (shut down the labs) — completing it pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSMABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. She says 'You know what I'm gonna do? Meditate', walks to the balcony — follow her, choose Accept. That session is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Whether it counts toward the trophy is still UNCONFIRMED (PowerPyx, KeenGamer) — do it anyway, and keep a Chapter 1 save.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 spots. Eight outdoor spots count twice (once per character); the Chapter 1 balcony session counts once, and the final Ascent Meditation on Mount Kalaga counts once. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18 [3][5][6][9][12][13][14].

steps.text: FIRST — Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and Accept. This session vanishes after Chapter 1.

Meditate at the 8 outdoor spots with BOTH Jason and Lucia (each counts twice): Smooth Sand (sandbar west of Capri), Swamp (Buckskin Swamp dock), Worn Stone (Camp Moonflower, Emerald River), Red Rocks (Manifest Canyon), Water Wheel (ruined paper mill, south Moreau), Jutting Cliff (Mount Kalaga National Park), Waterfall (north-west of Tallaloko), Seaside (Waning Sands beach).
A spot shows a purple icon on the map once you are close to it.
Finish with the Ascent Meditation at the Mount Kalaga summit stone circle — it only appears on the map after the other meditations.
Each meditation raises Focus; a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
UNCONFIRMED: whether the Chapter 1 balcony session is required for the trophy. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both leave it open — doing it costs nothing and removes the risk.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Bret Vogel). His questline is Jason-only: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do his quest and he marks hunting spots on the map. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed [3].

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, wait for Bret Vogel's text (Jason only) and go to Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
In his first quest Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' — retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
Hunt the animals he requests at the purple-marked spots and bring them to Bret as Jason.
Track hunting under Map > Activities > Target Deck — 15 Target Decks exist and the 100% checklist needs all 15.
Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still being confirmed — work through Bret's questline and it should come naturally.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so you will pass this trophy on the way. Collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress [3][4][5].

steps.text: Collect cards around Leonida and complete any 3 full sets.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Keep collecting after this pops — 15 of 18 sets are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Any mix counts: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. Hold Up then R1 to scan (WAiNK unlocks automatically in Chapter 1). The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations [3][4][5].

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on the phone (hold Up to use it instantly).
Look at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or No Flusher tag and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan anything new as you explore — there are far more than 100 scannable spots, so any 100 will do.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way — and you can skip the 10 hardest challenges entirely. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies [3][4][5].

steps.text: View and track challenges under Progress > Challenges (a checkmark shows when one is completed).
Play normally through the story and the 100% grind — most challenges finish themselves.
Leave this for late: once you have ~40 done, pick the easiest remaining ones to reach 50, then keep going to 70 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Available from Chapter 2 (after Coffee Break), when you can free-roam together: call your partner with Right + Triangle. It also pops automatically during the large bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars [3][5][9].

steps.text: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic — and drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
If a helicopter chases you, shoot it until it leaves. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Available from Chapter 2 (after Coffee Break). Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level active between shops — do not clear it. The unlock is delayed: it pops about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop [3][5][9].

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) in a row while the police chase you the whole time — stay inside the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level.
Loot a couple of items per shop and ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
A good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs).
If it does not pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th — and wait: it unlocks roughly 30 seconds after leaving the final shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of 557 at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Scanning with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops naturally [3][4].

steps.text: Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan vehicles you have not seen before.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by — each new unique vehicle adds to the database.
Getting inside a vehicle also discovers it, but scanning is faster.
Check totals under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds. PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang enemies [3][5][9].

steps.text: Buff your Focus first: eat/drink, or wash your face / shower at home; consume Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus.
Bring body armor (Ammu-Nations) and an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — accurate and full-auto.
Line up 5 gang enemies (e.g. at a Gang Operation), aim, press L3 + R3, and drop all 5 before the purple focus bar drains.
It gets easier as Focus levels up (4 levels; check Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Focus). Shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise Focus.
You may earn this naturally while working on other trophies — do not grind it early.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal — not one parked on the airfield. The plane at terminals E3/E4 is the easiest: enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away [3][9].

steps.text: Drive through a fence around the airfield and head to the plane docked at departure terminals E3/E4.
Use the stairs next to the boarding bridge — the door leads directly into the plane (or enter on foot through the terminal).
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is delayed, so keep flying until it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) and use it in combat. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base [3][5].

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — to reach the tanks in the south of the base.
Enter a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe-code note, and loot the safe [3][9].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun (it stays in your inventory permanently).
Pick a jewelry store — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target — and approach the locked back door.
Choose the Snap Gun prompt, not the kick — kicking triggers the alarm.
Inside, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and rob it — the first vault is part of the mission. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip for security-van locations. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so it overlaps with Hot Together [3][5].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it teaches the vault robbery and counts as your first.
Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash bags alone (hold Right to hand off a bag).
Afterwards, buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000 each; finish his earlier quests first — 2 Payday Loans — if he does not sell them yet).
Follow a marked van to a bank, enter while the vault is open, rob it, then escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognizable.
There are 8 large bank vaults; you need any 5 for this trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist. Up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier by stopping a roaming armored truck near a bank, planting a sticky bomb on its back door and blowing it open [3].

steps.text: Easiest path: finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery inside it counts.
Or, earlier: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it up.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) — the trophy only pops after you escape.
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible [3][4].

steps.text: Get a plane and fly a grid over the map, covering every black-fogged area.
The trophy pops once the whole map is unfogged.
Exploring as you play also feeds the 100% checklist (200 vehicles, 100 animals, 100 WAiNK scans).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total; you need only 1 per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% checklist. They are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress [3][5].

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs — yellow icons on the map.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs (scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you robbed).
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both list this trophy as currently unknown — no verified method exists yet. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has confirmed the trigger. Do not trust a method that cites no source; check back after players report it.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. METHOD UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx and KeenGamer both list this trophy as currently unknown, with no verified unlock method as of 21 Nov 2026. The description is the only solid fact [3][5].

steps.text: What the description says: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
No published guide has confirmed the trigger yet — PowerPyx marks it 'currently unknown'.
KeenGamer likewise says the exact trigger is still being confirmed.
Best next step: try Ocean Beach bars and viewpoints after the story, and watch for player reports — do not grind blind.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both list this trophy as currently unknown — no verified method exists yet. The description suggests smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no guide has confirmed which showroom or how. Do not trust a method that cites no source.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. METHOD UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx and KeenGamer both list this trophy as currently unknown, with no verified unlock method as of 21 Nov 2026 [3][5].

steps.text: What the description says: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
No published guide has confirmed the trigger yet — PowerPyx marks it 'currently unknown'.
KeenGamer likewise says the exact method is still unconfirmed.
Best next step: watch for player reports on which showroom and what counts as 'classic style' before grinding it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (Kolt & Associates' bowling alley) in Port Gellhorn, one of the Illegal Gang Operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police — not when you pick up the third item. Valuables collected on earlier visits still count, so it is not missable [3][5][9].

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Buy Sticky Bombs at an Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe.
Steal the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon).
Take the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' from the table in the north-east corner.
Loot the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it with Sticky Bombs).
Escape the police — the trophy pops on escape. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available from Chapter 2 (after Coffee Break), when you can switch between characters. Work out together: while you actively train one character, the other completes their training automatically [3][5][9].

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between Jason and Lucia.
Buy a fitness-club membership and always go together (hold Right, press Triangle to call your partner).
Work out with one character — the inactive partner trains alongside automatically, so you make double progress.
Check Strength under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon).
The trophy pops once both characters are at maximum Strength at the same time. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. It happens passively while you do robberies and other trophies. Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes police more aggressive [3][5].

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so you can see actions counting.
Play normally: every robbery and enemy encounter counts toward the 500.
Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) → Hardened (incapacitate, don't kill) → Violent (killing) → Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) → Irredeemable (permanent).
Do NOT push to Irredeemable: it is permanent and cops shoot on sight more often.
Check your count by selecting the trophy in the trophy list (PSN tracks it to 500). If short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but expect Psycho heat.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — a guess, not a confirmation. KeenGamer also lists it as unconfirmed. Do not grind a guess.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. METHOD UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed (not confirmed) to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. KeenGamer also lists it as unconfirmed [3][5].

steps.text: What the description hints: 'Second time's the charm' — succeeding on a second attempt at something.
PowerPyx's current belief (unconfirmed): related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
KeenGamer lists the unlock method as unconfirmed.
Best next step: wait for player confirmation before grinding; retrying failed attempts (e.g. Payday Loan jobs) is the cheapest guess.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline — a guess, not a confirmation. KeenGamer also lists it as unconfirmed. Do not grind a guess.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? METHOD UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed (not confirmed) to be from a UFO questline. KeenGamer also lists it as unconfirmed [3][5].

steps.text: What the description hints: witnessing something strange and unexplained.
PowerPyx's current belief (unconfirmed): from a UFO questline.
KeenGamer lists the unlock method as unconfirmed.
Best next step: watch for player reports on the UFO questline before hunting it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. Sources differ: PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed. Neither is confirmed in-game yet.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. METHOD UNCONFIRMED — sources differ: PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, while KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed. Both versions are shown [3][5].

steps.text: What the description says: bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by.
Version A (PowerPyx, believed): kick enemies while driving a motorcycle.
Version B (KeenGamer): a melee drive-by elimination whose precise method is still being confirmed.
Best next step: try motorcycle kicks first (cheapest test), and watch for player confirmation.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative — not in one go). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally with the robbery grind; bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per robbery [3].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect Marked Bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 counts across all robberies; you do not need to deliver it at once.
Bank vaults (Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…) pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It accumulates across every shop purchase in the game and comes naturally during a full playthrough — weapons, ammo, clothes, food and vehicle upgrades all count [3][5].

steps.text: Spend normally at shops as you play — the total accumulates across all shops.
Big-ticket spending (weapons, ammo, vehicle upgrades, clothes) moves the total fastest.
Do not overspend early: reserve $160,000 for the 8 purchasable garages (Little Boxes) first.
If short at the end, buy expensive items until the $100,000 total is reached.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count). Total cost $160,000. Garage purchases open through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Extra parking capacity also helps On the Spot [3][5][9].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock garage purchases in the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
Reserve $160,000 in total for all 8 garages before spending freely on clothes, hair or tattoos.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — the 4 story garages do not need to be bought.
The extra parking space helps register 10 vehicles for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep registration costs down. Later Chapter 3 progress also allows Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations [3][5][9].

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Steal an eligible vehicle and take it to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register to register the vehicle.
Use cheap cars and bikes to keep costs down; initially Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers.
Later, Chapter 3 progress permits Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations — register 10 in total.
